prompt_outputs.deliverable_from_prompt: one full painted scene, 1024 x 1536 pixels, portrait. Arda stands in the lower third, slightly left of centre, full body, about 45% of the picture height, facing right toward the zombies. On the tram rails up the middle of the avenue, a red-and-cream vintage tram (tram red #D7263D body, paper cream #F4EBDD roof and window band) fills the middle distance, with no text and no livery. Neoclassical facades (generic, unnamed, with no signs and no letters) line both sides and narrow toward the top. In the mid-ground 8 to 12 zombies shamble toward him: desaturated olive skin #7D8B6A, pale glowing eyes, everyday clothes in muted colours (office shirt, student hoodie, shopper cardigan), torn at the hems. The sky is dusk: bosphorus blue #1B4965 at the top, simit gold #E9A23B glow at the horizon.
prompt_outputs.prompt_notes: Full scene, so no key colour (the cut-out rule does not apply). DESIGN CHOICE: Arda holds a silver fork here; every other hero image has empty hands. Owner to decide. Save the chosen image as F1.png.
